verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing states that every pull request gets its own preview, and that public endpoints are live from the moment a deploy happens, so automatic per-PR preview deployments are a first-party capability. The evidence comes only from homepage marketing lines; there are no in-depth docs and no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each PR preview gets a public URL, detailed setup/configuration docs for PR environments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
